name: The Haunting of Monika After Story
source: A Doki Doki Literature Club Mod;Play as an adolescent broke male who is a chronic Monika After Story player. However, his life turns upside down when he installs an unreleased mod.
translation: Doki Doki文学俱乐部模组；扮演一名身无分文的青少年男性，长期沉迷于Monika After Story玩家。然而，当他安装了一个未发布的模组后，他的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。
